summary: Updated the plan to use one canonical Vite ready parser that strips ANSI escapes and matches Local URLs anywhere in the line, with tests for arrow-prefixed and plain banners.
Added readyPromise handling to the ProcessManager and dev_server.start plan so duplicate starts during the starting window wait for defined url, pid, and startedAt fields.
Added the missing sync-lock declaration file update to the plan with the readLockStatus export signature.
Updated the plan so one-shot build and sync children are tracked by ProcessManager while running and are killed by stopAll during MCP shutdown.
Updated the sync summary plan step to bind startTime and derive matched/unmatched counts from the actual runOneShot state object before logging.
Added the test helper and ServerContext literal audit/update requirement to the implementation strategy, file list, and US-004 story.
Added plan requirements for dev_server.start to clean up and remove stale process handles on startup failure, plus tests and acceptance coverage for retry-after-failure.
Amended the plan to add tree-kill as a v1 dependency, require Windows process-tree termination in ProcessManager.stop(), and verify descendant PIDs in no-orphan acceptance tests.
Strengthened shutdown acceptance and Verification L to capture descendant and port-5173 listener PIDs, assert captured PIDs are gone, and verify port 5173 is no longer listening after MCP shutdown.
Amended the plan to spell out the sync-lock refactor helpers, type declarations, and same-module unit tests needed for readLockStatus.

Amended the plan to make tools/overview-mcp/src/__tests__/sync-now.test.ts the canonical integration test for the sync summary output and removed the ambiguous scripts/__tests__/sync-watch-status fallback.
Made serial execution explicitly required for mcp-ops-tools and replaced the parallel handoff command with the serial handoff command.
